Sorry, my bad. They didn't sell or gave away 200k units, The game has sold an estimated 25,000 copies and $200k gross revenue. The game is even based on a tutorial, so it's not unique at all. That's were I got the numbers from, as I get the newsletter from the tutor (which is known as CodeMonkey, you can find him on Youtube).

People don't care about the use of AI as long as the game is fun. I'm almost 100% sure that nobody bought the game, because it advertises its usage of AI. They bought it, because it looks cute and plays fine.

If you don't like the use of AI, that's okay. But AI generated games will get better and sooner or late the terrible slop (e.g. the Vampire Survivor or Supermarket Simulator clones) will vanish. This one stays as an example how to use AI successfully.
